description.en: The KV delta chain (W-DELTA, R-BEBOPDB D.1 #3). A catalogue write no longer rewrites the whole image: Catalog::to_bytes on a catalogue loaded from bytes appends one record per changed key ({ref NEXT, OP put|remove, KLEN, VLEN, key, value}, packed) and a new 8-cell root {n, KIDX, KBLOB, VIDX, VBLOB, VERSION=3, ref DELTA, D} that re-uses the v2 base arrays. Every reader replays base + chain oldest-first: Kv::load_checked / Kv::decode, the zero-copy KvIn (overlay of the newest op per key + a merged order), CatalogView, the bebop-wasm reader (via Kv::load_checked) and oracle.py and kv.bp (kv3_fold, a map-free merged replay; its projection memo `m` refuses v3 with -3). The crc of every record is checked wherever the base's is. The writer compacts to v2 -- byte-identical to the old writer (golden pinned from the old code) -- when the chain would pass 32 records, superseded cells would pass a quarter of live cells, the base is v1, or the arena is full; superseded_cells is now written for KV images. A Durable Object therefore writes the chunk holding the superblock pages and the tail chunk for one price edit instead of every chunk. No route, request or response shape changes.
description.uk: Редагування каталогу більше не переписує весь образ: дописується один запис на змінений ключ і новий корінь (v3); читачі відтворюють ланцюжок; ущільнення після 32 записів або чверті мертвих клітинок.

producer.what: append_delta_with (records + v3 root, the compaction trigger, sup_delta)
chain_in (every claim of the chain bounded)

consumer.what: with_catalog (owner edits: load, edit, to_bytes, save)
with_catalog in the object (CatalogView over v3 bytes; memo forgotten on write)

on_disk_format: bebop-store KV image v3 = v2 base + delta chain (crates/bebop-store/src/kv/delta.rs header); compaction writes v2. A Worker build that predates W-DELTA REFUSES a v3 image (rollback risk).
